bays.note: The hitting-bay building is the long low block across the whole NORTH end of the net (mosaic about x 1185-1545, y 935-985, about 85 x 12 m, flat gray concrete roof [139,147,126]); gis:11193149's centroid lies in it. Its NORTH face onto the east-west road is an office-like facade: light gray panel wall, punched windows, a vertical blue-green glass strip and a glazed ground-floor entrance, rock garden and pines along the sidewalk. The three bay tiers open SOUTH onto the field (not visible from the street). gis:16094889 and gis:17425670 have centroids inside the netted field, so they are not bay buildings: treat them as the net enclosure records (or drop); their street crops actually show the neighbouring buildings and the bay block.
